key_insight: QAccCert shows that quantum software engineering can combine FPGA and AI components to efficiently certify entanglement using CHSH inequality tests.
engineering_relevance: The work demonstrates a practical, system-level approach for building scalable quantum certification workflows that could later transfer to noisy NISQ hardware.
method: Hybrid certification framework built under QSE principles
Uses Qiskit AerSimulator for ideal quantum simulations
LLM-guided search optimizes parameters for CHSH violation
evidence_signal: In simulation, the approach reached 99.94% of the theoretical CHSH maximum of 2√2, outperforming random search in parameter exploration.
watch_item: The results are limited to ideal simulations, so performance on real quantum hardware with noise, decoherence, and FPGA integration still needs validation.
paper_title: Quantum Software Engineering in Practice: FPGA and AI Integration for Quantum Certification
